links.outcome: Sensitivity/specificity of ChatGPT-4.0 versus clinicians for trial eligibility identification against reference standard
links.effect: Both AI and clinicians had high specificity, but sensitivity varied. ChatGPT-4.0 was especially ineffective for neoadjuvant trials; clinicians performed better but heterogeneously; team-based assessment identified nearly all eligible patients.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 proved especially ineffective at screening for neoadjuvant trials, whereas medical professionals showed better, but heterogeneous performance.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM for clinical trial patient eligibility screening with multiprofessional team review

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of ChatGPT-4.0 versus clinicians for clinical trial eligibility screening using retrospective tumor board data.
